477093.name: Anexo Templo Etz Hajaim - Jabad
477093.note: 'Esta comunidad de judíos askenazi se forma en 1941 ... Entre 1944 y 1946 construyeron esta pequeña sinagoga ... A mediados de la década del ’80 el templo fue asumido por el movimiento Jabad Lubavitch, y experimentó un marcado renacimiento' (Guía de lugares de culto de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, tomo 4, Dirección General de Cultos, 2017: 'Templo Etz Hajaim - Beit Jabad', Julián Álvarez). Mid-1980s, so about 1986, when Jabad also took over the temple at Serrano 69 nearby (Beit Jabad Villa Crespo, March 1986; the same guide). Low: only 'the mid-80s', and Jabad Argentina's list of its houses first names it in Dec 2001 ('Templo Etz Hajaim'; not in Feb-Aug 2001), from 2004 'ANEXO TEMPLO ETZ HAJAIM - JABAD, Rabino: Iejiel Frenkel'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14.

477125.name: Beit Jabad Once - Litvische Shul
477125.note: 'they returned to South America in 5758 (1998) as shluchim in Buenos Aries under Rabbi Grunblatt ... In 5760, a new project came up. Rabbi Stawsky and his wife became the official shluchim of the Beis Chabad of Once, housed in the Litvishe Shul' (Beis Moshiach #895, Sept 2013). 'Asignado a la capital argentina, se le encargó la formación de un Beit Jabad en el barrio Once ... Allí había quedado abandonada una centenaria sinagoga (Litvishe Shil) y el Rabino Stawsky supo crear casi de la nada una hermosa y floreciente comunidad' (Comité Central Israelita del Uruguay, Oct 2012). 5760 ran from Sept 1999 to Sept 2000; it is in Jabad Argentina's first archived list of its houses (Feb 2001). Rabbi Stawsky died on Erev Sukkos 5773 (2012); his son-in-law Rabbi Mendy Kapeluschnik took over with his wife (Periodismo Kosher, Oct 2013). Medium: Jabad Argentina's list of Feb 2001 gives 'Litvishe shul - Beit Jabad Once. Rabino: Shaul Elituv' (and Stawsky in charge of its office classes), and from 2004 'Director: Rabino Aharón Stawsky'; Chabadpedia (unsourced) has Rabbi Shaul Moshe Elituv, after some years as mashpia of the Buenos Aires yeshiva, as shliach in Once and rabbi of the Litvishe Shul community, no year.

477080.name: Beis Chabad Palermo Soho
477080.note: Not in Jabad Argentina's list of its houses ('Batei Jabad', jabad.org.ar/beitjabad.asp) through 19 Feb 2006 (Wayback copies); in it by 6 April 2006 as 'BEIT JABAD PALERMO SOHO' (in Jan 2008: Rabino Tzvi Lipinski, Niceto Vega 5035). Its jabadsoho.com.ar domain was up by Nov 2006 and its chabad.org listing by Feb 2007. So about early 2006, 5766. Its new building at Malabia 2180: 'The 27th Chabad House in Buenos Aires, Argentina, will be inaugurated Thursday' (COLlive, 19 Aug 2009). The City's guide to places of worship (tomo 4, 2017) has 'La comunidad de Palermo Soho se fundó en agosto de 2009', the date of that building.

1473349.name: Centro Medico Maimonides
1473349.note: Bernardo Kliksberg in Tucumán 'visitó el centro médico Maimonides, establecido por Jabad Lubavitch de Tucumán con el apoyo de la gobernación' (Itón Gadol, 16 Nov 2010). Rabbi Daniel Levy: the province's health minister signed on to help build it, 'Within two years, the expansive building, four floors high, had been completed. In the meantime, the regional health minister had been appointed as minister of health for the entire country. He came personally for the dedication ceremony' (Juan Manzur, national health minister from July 2009); and the old mikvah 'served us well up until eight years ago. Since then, we have built another impressive mikveh inside the medical center we founded' (Beis Moshiach #1141, Nov 2018). So dedicated between mid-2009 and Nov 2010. Lamadrid 623 (with the Mikve Mei Menajem; AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2011-03-29.

477132.name: Beit Jabad Olleros
477132.note: 'Un Beit Jabad muy alegre: Una entrevista con el Rabino Yanki Birman director del Beit Jabad Olleros y 17 años de labor' (jabad.tv, Jabad Argentina's video site, 27 Feb 2018, post 8269): so about 2001 (counted back, medium). In Jabad Argentina's 2010 list: 'BEIT JABAD OLLEROS, Director: Rabino Ianki Birman, Olleros 2028' (no date). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14. Already in Jabad Argentina's first archived list of its houses (Feb 2001: 'Beit Jabad Olleros, Director: Rabino Ianki Birman, Olleros 2026'); the City's guide to places of worship (tomo 4, 2017): 'Entre finales de la década de 1990 y principios del nuevo milenio se instalan en esta antigua casa de Palermo'.
